q: By the oath of the winds that disperse
v.s: By those [winds] scattering [dust] dispersing [it]
v.c: By the winds scattering ˹dust˺,

q: And by the clouds that bear
v.s: And those [clouds] carrying a load [of water]
v.c: and ˹the clouds˺ loaded with rain,

q: And by the ships that move smoothly...
v.s: And those [ships] sailing with ease
v.c: and ˹the ships˺ gliding with ease,

q: And by those angels who distribute
v.s: And those [angels] apportioning [each] matter,
v.c: and ˹the angels˺ administering affairs by ˹Allah’s˺ command!

q: Indeed what you have been promised is undoubtedly true
v.s: Indeed, what you are promised is true.
v.c: Indeed, what you are promised is true.

v.s: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.
v.c: And the Judgment will certainly come to pass.

q: By the oath of the sky which have fixed
v.s: By the heaven containing pathways,
v.c: ˹And˺ by the heavens in their marvellous design!

q: You people are definitely divided in talks
(compared in your views about Qiyaamah, which some of you accept while others do not).
v.s: Indeed, you are in differing speech.
v.c: Surely you are ˹lost˺ in conflicting views ˹regarding the truth˺.

q: is he who is prone to turning away
v.s: Deluded away from it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is he who is deluded.
v.c: Only those ˹destined to be˺ deluded are turned away from it.

q: (who reject the belief in resurrection without valid reason be destroyed)...
v.s: Destroyed are the falsifiers
v.c: Condemned are the liars—

v.s: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.
v.c: those who are ˹steeped˺ in ignorance, totally heedless.

q: (with ridicule, as if in a hurry for it),
v.s: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"
v.c: They ask ˹mockingly˺, “When is this Day of Judgment?”

q: The day when they will be punished in the Fire.
v.s: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire.
v.c: ˹It is˺ the Day they will be tormented over the Fire.

q: (It will then be said to them)
“Taste your punishment! This is that which you sought to hurry.”
v.s: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."
v.c: ˹They will be told,˺ “Taste your torment! This is what you sought to hasten.”

q: Verily those with Taqwa shall be
v.s: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,
v.c: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and springs,

q: them. Indeed these people used to carry out good
v.s: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.
v.c: ˹joyfully˺ receiving what their Lord will grant them. Before this ˹reward˺ they were truly good-doers ˹in the world˺:

q: Little was it that they slept at night
(because they devoted their nights to worshipping Allaah).
v.s: They used to sleep but little of the night,
v.c: they used to sleep only little in the night,

m: And in the hours before dawn
q: During the closing portions of the night they would be seeking forgiveness
v.s: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,
v.c: and pray for forgiveness before dawn.

q: There was always a portion of their wealth
v.s: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.
v.c: And in their wealth there was a rightful share ˹fulfilled˺ for the beggar and the poor.

q: (signs demonstrating Towheed and Allaah's great power)
v.s: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]
v.c: There are ˹countless˺ signs on earth for those with sure faith,

v.s: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?
v.c: as there are within yourselves. Can you not see?

q: (of Qiyaamah). (The time for Qiyaamah has been fixed but has not been made known to man.))
v.s: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.
v.c: In heaven is your sustenance and whatever you are promised.

q: By the Rabb of the sky and the earth, this
is certainly the truth just as
v.s: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.
v.c: Then by the Lord of heaven and earth! ˹All˺ this is certainly as true as ˹the fact that˺ you can speak!

q: Has the story of Ibraheem ﵊ honourable guests
v.s: Has there reached you the story of the honoured guests of Abraham? -
v.c: Has the story of Abraham’s honoured guests reached you ˹O Prophet˺?

q: When they came to him and greeted with Salaam, he
said, “Peace be upon you too. You must be strangers
v.s: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace; [you are] a people unknown."
v.c: ˹Remember˺ when they entered his presence and greeted ˹him with˺, “Peace!” He replied, “Peace ˹be upon you˺!” ˹Then he said to himself,˺ “˹These are˺ an unfamiliar people.”

q: He then went to his family and returned with a fat
v.s: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf.
v.c: Then he slipped off to his family and brought a fat ˹roasted˺ calf,

q: He served it to them and
(when they did not partake of it because angels do not eat food)
he said, “Are you not going to eat
v.s: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"
v.c: and placed it before them, asking, “Will you not eat?”

m: and they gave him glad tidings
q: (thinking that they may have come for some sinister purpose).
They said, “Do not be afraid,” and they gave him the good news of a child
(blessed with knowledge that was to be born to him i.e. Ishaaq.)
v.s: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.
v.c: ˹They did not eat,˺ so he grew fearful of them. They reassured ˹him˺, “Do not be afraid,” and gave him good news of a knowledgeable son.

v.s: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"
v.c: Then his wife came forward with a cry, clasping her forehead ˹in astonishment˺, exclaiming, “˹A baby from˺ a barren, old woman!”

q: (you will therefore certainly bear a child).
He is the Wise, the All Knowing.”
(He knows why and to whom a child should be born.)
v.s: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."
v.c: They replied, “Such has your Lord decreed. He is truly the All-Wise, All-Knowing.”

q: (Why have you been sent to earth?)
v.s: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
v.c: ˹Later,˺ Abraham asked, “What is your mission, O messengers?”
v.h: Destruction of the People of Lot

q: They replied, “We have been sent to
v.s: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals
v.c: They replied, “We have actually been sent to a wicked people,

v.s: To send down upon them stones of clay,
v.c: to send upon them stones of ˹baked˺ clay,

q: “...which have been marked by your Rabb
(each stone bore the name of the person it was meant to kill)
v.s: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."
v.c: marked by your Lord for the transgressors.”

q: “(However, we shall not harm the Mu'mineen because before inflicting the punishment,)
We shall remove those who are Mu'mineen from the town
(by informing them when to leave the town).'
v.s: So We brought out whoever was in them [i.e., the cities] of the believers.
v.c: Then ˹before the torment˺ We evacuated the believers from the city.

q: We found only a single home of Muslims there
v.s: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.
v.c: But We only found one family that had submitted ˹to Allah˺.

q: for those who fear a painful punishment.
(The ruins of the cities of these people are still visible today.)
v.s: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
v.c: And We have left a sign there ˹as a lesson˺ for those who fear the painful punishment.

q: Moosa ﵊ when We sent him to Fir'oun with a clear proof
(with miracles to prove that he was Allaah's true Nabi).
v.s: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
v.c: And in ˹the story of˺ Moses ˹was another lesson,˺ when We sent him to Pharaoh with compelling proof,

q: However, Fir'oun turned away together with his party (his people and forces) and said, “(Moosa ﵊ is) Either a (clever) magician or a madman!”
v.s: But he turned away with his supporters and said, "A magician or a madman."
v.c: but Pharaoh was carried away by his power, saying ˹of Moses˺, “A magician or a madman!”

q: and his army and cast them into the ocean for he was to be blamed
(for misleading the people and the rely inviting the punishment).
v.s: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.
v.c: So We seized him and his soldiers, casting them into the sea while he was blameworthy.

q: the Aad when we sent a
wind to them that was devoid of
v.s: And in ʿAad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.
v.c: And in ˹the story of˺ ’Âd ˹was another lesson,˺ when We sent against them the devastating wind.
v.h: Destruction of the People of Hûd

q: It completely destroyed everything it passed over
(totally destroying the Aad and everything they had).
v.s: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.
v.c: There was nothing it came upon that it did not reduce to ashes. Destruction of the People of Ṣâliḥ

q: (after they had killed the miraculous camel)
v.s: And in Thamūd, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."
v.c: And in ˹the story of˺ Thamûd ˹was another lesson,˺ when they were told, “Enjoy yourselves ˹only˺ for a ˹short˺ while.”

q: They transgressed against the command of their Rabb, so a
seized them as they looked on.
v.s: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.
v.c: Still they persisted in defying the commands of their Lord, so they were overtaken by a ˹mighty˺ blast while they were looking on.

q: They were unable to even stand
and were helpless to protect themselves.
v.s: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.
v.c: Then they were not able to rise up, nor were they helped.

q: (all these nations mentioned above). (Allaah's punishment destroyed them because)
They were indeed a sinful nation
v.s: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.
v.c: And the people of Noah ˹had also been destroyed˺ earlier. They were truly a rebellious people.
v.h: Destruction of the People of Noah

q: (creating this and everything else is easy for Us because)
v.s: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.
v.c: We built the universe with ˹great˺ might, and We are certainly expanding ˹it˺.

q: And we have spread the earth out
(for other creation to live completely easily on it).
How excellently we have created the wild!
v.s: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.
v.c: As for the earth, We spread it out. How superbly did We smooth it out!

q: (such as male and female, hot and cold, sweet and sour, etc)
so that you may take heed
v.s: And of all things We created two mates [i.e., counterparts]; perhaps you will remember.
v.c: And We created pairs of all things so perhaps you would be mindful.

v.s: So flee to God. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
v.c: So ˹proclaim, O Prophet˺: “Flee to Allah! I am truly sent by Him with a clear warning to you.

q: Do not ascribe another Ilaah with Allaah. Verily I
am a clear warner to you from Him.
v.s: And do not make [as equal] with God another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
v.c: And do not set up another god with Allah. I am truly sent by Him with a clear warning to you.”

q: (just as the Mushrikeen of Makkah opposed Rasulullaah ﷺ)
whenever a Rasool came to those before them, they
said that he is a magician or a madman.
v.s: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."
v.c: Similarly, no messenger came to those before them without being told: “A magician or a madman!”

m: Have they transmitted it to them
Have they transmitted it to them
q: (that they will all reject the Ambiyaa ﵊?)
(the real reason why they all behave in such a manner is that)
v.s: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.
v.c: Have they passed this ˹cliché˺ down to one another? In fact, they have ˹all˺ been a transgressing people.

q: (do not be grieved by the manner in which they behave towards you),
for you will not be blamed
v.s: So leave them, [O Muhammad], for you are not to be blamed.
v.c: So ˹now˺ turn away from them ˹O Prophet˺, for you will not be blamed.

q: because advice is beneficial for the Mu'mineen.
v.s: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.
v.c: But ˹continue to˺ remind. For certainly reminders benefit the believers.

q: I have created man and Jinn only to worship
(Besides the many various other reasons the most important objective for creating men and Jinn is for them to recognise who Allaah is).
v.s: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
v.c: I did not create jinn and humans except to worship Me.

q: from them nor do I want them to feed Me.
v.s: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.
v.c: I seek no provision from them, nor do I need them to feed Me.

q: Without doubt, Allaah is the Sustainer
the Possessor of absolute power, Strong.
(Allaah is not in need of His creation, but they are most definitely in need of Him).
v.s: Indeed, it is God who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.
v.c: Indeed, Allah ˹alone˺ is the Supreme Provider—Lord of all Power, Ever Mighty.

m: so let them not ask Me to hasten
so let them not ask Me to hasten
q: which shall be similar to the punishment of those like them
(those who committed kufr in the past),
(do not be in impatient for the punishment to come because it will certainly arrive at its appointed time).
v.s: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their companions [i.e., predecessors], so let them not impatiently urge Me.
v.c: The wrongdoers will certainly have a share ˹of the torment˺ like that of their predecessors. So do not let them ask Me to hasten ˹it˺.

q: be to the Kuffaar because of the day
(at the battle of Badr and later on the day of Qiyaamat).
v.s: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
v.c: Woe then to the disbelievers when they face their Day which they are warned of!
